issues.on_page: Charges for services 174,487 (p15-16: Garbage 110,206, Ambulance 33,139, General 19,206, Pool 11,601, Horse Arena 335)
issues.issue: 63% of the line is garbage charges. Under the user rule (2026-10-28), garbage/refuse goes to Utility Charges, ambulance to Ambulance Fees and pool to Recreation Fees. Consider the dominant category (Utility Charges) with a review note, or keep it and flag it.

issues.on_page: Contributions and grants 1,060,250 (p2: capital grants and contributions 981,000 general government + 75,000 public safety)
issues.issue: The grantor is not stated. A capital grant of 1,056,000 is likely government (state/federal) money rather than private donations, so the category is doubtful. The line carries a review note.
Utility fund sales are category Utility Charges under the user rule (2026-10-28). user_rules.py won't reclassify this because receipts carry no fund name.

Garbage charges should be category Utility Charges (user rule 2026-10-28). The detail_category is refuse/sanitation charges, but the label 'Charges for services' means user_rules.py won't reclassify it.
Ambulance charges should be category Ambulance Fees (user rule 2026-10-28). user_rules.py won't catch it from the label.
Pool charges should be category Recreation Fees (user rule 2026-10-28).

issues.on_page: Horse Arena department: Charges for services 335
issues.issue: Arena charges probably belong in Recreation Fees (user rule 2026-10-28).
'Vehicle expense' may be vehicle repairs/maintenance as well as fuel, so the cost-type category is a judgment call.

The user rule (2026-10-26/28) relabels capital outlay lines 'Capital Outlay: <function>' (here Capital Outlay: Streets/Highways), as was done for the General Fund department lines. This one wasn't relabelled.
